name: MEL02

address.note: ITK Research (fetched): 'a 5.6-hectare footprint at 200 Palmers Road, Truganina, immediately across the road from Stack's existing MEL01 campus'; also datacenterHawk (not fetchable). STACK page gives only Truganina. By OSM numbering even numbers are on the east side of Palmers Rd; 200A Palmers Rd point is ~1.3km south of MEL01. PlanningAlerts WYP14741/24 (Aug 2024) at 200 Palmers Rd is for business identification signage (source 5) - occupant not named

lat.note: geocoded: Nominatim address point 200A Palmers Rd (east side of Palmers Rd); approximate - no OSM building for MEL02

builder.note: not found. Hickory said in Nov 2025 that 'Hickory and STACK are driving Australia's largest data centre pipeline, with more than 350MW currently under development' (MEL01C+D = 108MW, so this may include MEL02) and hickory.com.au/project/mel02/ redirects to STACK's Melbourne page - suggestive but not confirmation

mw_it.note: STACK MEL02 page (fetched): 252MW critical capacity, 1 building, 21,000 m2 technical space, 3,000 m2 office/storage, 14 acres (5.6ha)

mw_grid.note: STACK page: 'dedicated onsite 132KV utility substation' with 'total gross capacity of 300+MW' - substation capacity, not facility demand

authority.note: not found; Wyndham LGA. The Mar 2024 data centre application WYP14522/24 is at 369 Palmers Rd (MEL01C/D parcel), not MEL02. ITK's WYP14790/24 and WYP14905/24 refer to CDC Laverton

construction_end.note: ITK (source 8, fetched): 'Structure topped-out in late 2025 with 2026 in-service target for fit-out completion'. Baxtel (fetched): MEL02 planned 2026 (source 9), MEL02B phase 2027 (source 4). Coloprice lists it as operational (source 3) - unconfirmed

open_questions: Hickory's Dec 2021 groundbreaking article lists property 148-248 Leakes Road, which by address numbering lies east of Palmers Rd near 200 Palmers Rd - possible link to MEL02 land unverified
